class.name: CameraFollow
class.description: A follow camera that uses an array based fixed delay to add an easing effect to the following. The camera follows [param Target] and is delayed by [param Delay Frames Count] number of physics steps. The camera is offset from the [param Target] by [param Offset], and uses [method Node3D::look_at] to remain pointed at [param Target].

members.member: The [Node3D] that the camera should follow and focus on. Stored internally as ObjectID.
[Vector3] offset from [param Target] that the camera will maintain.
[Vector3] offset applied to the camera's look_at to change the camera tilt angle.
The number of physics steps behind the [param Target] that the camera will be. This cannot be changed at runtime without errors. This must be greater than zero to for changes to apply.
